1 · Google Play tester installation

You must sign in with your Google account to install the app. Sign in to both the browser and Google Play Store using the same approved tester account: jonathan@trackvision.app for Jonathan’s tablet. Another Google account must be added to the TrackVision tester list before it can install this internal-test app. Open the tester link, join if prompted, then select Download test app → Install or Update.
